mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% over a 3-month period, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above their 1-month growth thresholds signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS show positive 1-month growth, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic supply recovery phase, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 signals improving manufacturing capacity and reduced supply chain bottlenecks, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-pandemic supply recovery when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high unemployment rate (at or above 5.0%) signals weak labor market conditions that constrain consumer spending and corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is at or above 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 240.0 in the last 3 months signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.0 over a 3-month period, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 1-month growth thresholds signals robust consumer and housing demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST show positive 1-month growth, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 1.0%), a rising federal funds rate signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
